name: Content Weaver AI Lite — by Barking Llama
author: grandllama

sections.description:
Content Weaver AI Lite turns your WordPress dashboard into an AI-powered content studio. Import from RSS feeds, spin or rewrite articles, and generate new posts on demand — all without sending data to third-party servers. Whether you’re building a small autoblog or testing AI workflows, Lite gives you total control using your own OpenAI-compatible key.

This lightweight, privacy-friendly version by Barking Llama runs entirely on your WordPress site. It’s ideal for users who want to explore AI content workflows without relying on external services or sharing data.

Highlights

  • Uses your own API key for OpenAI-compatible providers (e.g., OpenAI, DeepSeek)
  • Manual text generation interface (chat/completions)
  • Simple RSS import — one feed, up to three items per run, saved as Drafts
  • Local Spintax utility ({a|b|c} syntax) with zero network calls
  • No telemetry, no remote calls to Content Weaver servers
  • Compliant, secure, and open-source — GPLv2 or later

This Lite version exists specifically for WordPress.org distribution and is designed to be simple, self-contained, and fully compliant with WordPress guidelines.

External Services

This plugin can connect directly from your WordPress site to the following external services.
No data is ever sent to Content Weaver servers in Lite.

OpenAI API (chat/completions)

  • When: Only if you select provider “OpenAI” and enter an OpenAI API key in the settings.
  • What: Model name and your prompt/messages (the API key is sent in the Authorization header).
  • Why: To generate or rewrite text content on Manual and RSS rewrite pages.
  • Domain: https://api.openai.com/v1
  • Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
  • Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

DeepSeek API (chat/completions)

  • When: Only if you select provider “DeepSeek” and enter a DeepSeek API key.
  • What: Model name and your prompt/messages (the API key is sent in the Authorization header).
  • Why: To generate or rewrite text content.
  • Domain: https://api.deepseek.com/v1
  • Terms: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html
  • Privacy: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html

Openverse API (Public Domain images)

  • When: Only if you choose Public Domain (Openverse) as your Featured Image mode.
  • What: A search query derived from your post title/content.
  • Why: To suggest or download public domain (CC0) images.
  • Domain: https://api.openverse.engineering/v1/images/
  • Info: https://wordpress.org/openverse/
  • Terms: https://docs.openverse.org/terms_of_service.html
  • Privacy: https://openverse.org/privacy

User-Provided RSS Feeds

  • When: When you run the RSS Lite importer.
  • What: Standard HTTP request to the feed URL you configure.
  • Why: To retrieve items to rewrite and import as drafts (up to 3 per run).

Notes:
– Lite never sends data to Content Weaver servers.
– OpenAI/DeepSeek requests are only made when you explicitly provide an API key.

Features

  • Manual AI text generation — Create or rewrite posts using your own OpenAI-compatible key.
  • RSS Lite import — Process one feed manually (up to 3 items per run) and save as Drafts.
  • Spintax editor — Rewrite text locally using {a|b|c} syntax (no external API calls).
  • Featured Image modes — None, Default, Site Icon, or Public Domain (Openverse).
  • No telemetry or tracking — Everything runs locally or through your chosen provider.
  • Optional upgrade path — Connect to Content Weaver Cloud or upgrade to Pro for automation.

Upgrade to Pro

Looking for automation, scheduling, and multi-feed workflows?
Content Weaver AI Pro connects to Content Weaver Cloud, uses managed API keys (no need for your own), and unlocks advanced features like Story Stream, Content Mixer, affiliate automation, and image generation.
Learn more at https://contentweaverai.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the contentweaver-ai-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins → Installed Plugins in WordPress.
  3. Go to Content Weaver AI Lite in your admin menu.
  4. Enter your provider, API key, and model on the Dashboard.
  5. Configure a single RSS feed under “RSS Lite” and click Run Now.
sections.faq:
Can I use Lite without an API key?

Yes. You can still use the Spintax tools locally with no network calls.
AI text generation and RSS rewriting require an OpenAI-compatible API key.

Does Lite send data to Content Weaver servers?

No. Lite never calls Content Weaver servers. It only communicates directly with your selected OpenAI-compatible provider using your key.

Which providers are supported?

Any OpenAI-compatible provider, including OpenAI and DeepSeek.
Non-compatible APIs are not supported in Lite.

Does Lite generate images?

Not directly. Lite can pull Public Domain images via Openverse for Featured Images.
AI image generation is part of Content Weaver Pro.

Do my Lite API keys carry over to Pro?

No. Lite uses your own API keys.
Pro uses Content Weaver’s managed API infrastructure and provider keys — optimized for speed, reliability, and higher token limits.
You’ll never need to enter your own keys in Pro.

Can I add affiliate links?

Yes. Lite lets you add your own affiliate callouts into generated content.
Pro automates affiliate placement and link management inside generated posts.
